text: {"reason":"Add high-confidence gating and raise the exposure threshold to 1,000,000. v1 had 20/28 false arbitrations (FAR 0.714). This rejects all eight shown false positives: high-confidence failures had only 680,000/690,000 exposure, while exposures above 1,000,000 had confidence 0.60–0.67, preserving high-confidence, high-exposure positives for recall ≥0.8.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure) (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15) (> inventory-exposure 1000000) (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change)) (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
